name: SkyeChip Berhad
summary: SkyeChip Berhad designs and manufactures integrated circuits in silicon intellectual property (IP) products in Malaysia, Singapore, China, Taiwan, the United States, the Republic of Korea, Hong Kong, and Vietnam. It is also involved in scientific research and technological development in the field of science, engineering and technology, provision of semiconductor IP, IC, and software and application-specific IC design and development; new product introduction engineering; and high-volume manufacturing enablement.
